title: Blade's Edge Mountains
body: The Blade's Edge Mountains are a maze of red canyons in the north of Outland, crowned by great curving spikes of stone. This is gronn country: Gruul the Dragonkiller, who once tore the black dragonflight from the sky and left its bones on the spires, rules from his lair in the north, and his sons lord over the ogre clans who fight one another for their favor. Night elves, gnomes, the Horde and the Cenarion Expedition have carved out footholds all the same, and the half-ogre Mok'Nathal hold out in the east.

title: Sylvanaar
body: Sylvanaar is a night elf town in the southwest of the mountains, raised in a short time by elven magic on land its founders found empty, and around it they are coaxing the Living Grove to grow at an unnatural pace into a defensive woodland. The gnome Toshley and his scientists settled here first, until their machines made a mess of the grove and the elves sent them up to the Razor Ridge, which Toshley counts a blessing.

title: Thunderlord Stronghold
body: Thunderlord Stronghold was the seat of the Thunderlord clan until those orcs drank the blood of Mannoroth and abandoned it. The Bladespire ogres moved into the empty halls, and the Horde has since driven them out and holds the town in the old clan's name, while its scholar hunts the clan's lost relics to appease its restless dead. Rexxar, Champion of the Horde, has come here seeking his people.

parts.body: With the relics returned, the ghost of Garm Wolfbrother, last chieftain of the Thunderlord, rose to tell Rexxar that the Mok'Nathal live beyond the Razor Ridge, and are in danger.

title: Rexxar
body: Rexxar, Champion of the Horde, is Mok'Nathal, of mixed orc and ogre blood. He made his name on Azeroth, roaming the wilds with his bear Misha, and once took Thrall's place at a summit that proved to be an ambush. Now he has crossed the Dark Portal, chasing rumors of his people, and at Thunderlord Stronghold he keeps his hawk Spirit, his boar Huffer and his bear beside him.

parts.body: Rexxar is the son of Leoroxx, chief of the Mok'Nathal. Thirty years ago he left to follow the Horde, against his father's will, and Leoroxx has never forgiven him.

parts.body: The ogres who harass the Mok'Nathal are no simple raiders: the sons of Gruul command the Bloodmaul to destroy them, to win the gronn's favor.

title: Mok'Nathal Village
body: Mok'Nathal Village lies in the east of the mountains, where the Mok'Nathal still survive: a people of mixed orc and ogre blood, once honored by orc shamans before the clans fell to demonic corruption. Their spiritcallers keep the memory of the ancestors alive in flame. Enemies press in from every side, and the chief, Leoroxx, judges outsiders harshly: those who come, he says, understand neither his people nor their struggle to survive.

parts.body: Some of the souls bound into the glowing orbs of the ethereals at Razaan's Landing are the souls of Mok'Nathal ancestors, and Leoroxx called it a defilement of his people's honored dead.

title: Dragons' End
body: Dragons' End is a valley of old bones. Here the gronn and the Bladespire ogres brought down the black dragons Deathwing had left on Draenor, and Gruul impaled their bodies on the spires, where the remains still hang. To the north Daggermaw Canyon runs past the ogres' Circle of Blood toward Gruul's Lair, and outside the arena an alchemist who hates the gronn, Baron Sablemane, receives guests with a black whelp at his side.

parts.body: Sablemane's hatred is personal: the gronn slaughtered his people and his children. In battle at a son of Gruul's altar he shed his human guise. He is a black dragon.

title: Ogri'la
body: High on a western terrace, reached only by flight, lies Ogri'la, the ogre heaven the clans below whisper about. Its ogres, many of them two-headed, have gained keen minds from the Apexis crystals that grow around their home, relics of a vanished arakkoa sect, and they want only to live in peace, which the demons, the ethereals and the black dragons of the terraces will not allow. The Sha'tari Skyguard keeps an outpost just to the north.

parts.body: A staff from Ogri'la sharpened the mind of Mog'dorg the Wizened, who leads a secret resistance among the Bloodmaul, and with the sons of Gruul dead he hopes to bring that clarity to all his people.

title: Evergrove
body: Evergrove is the Cenarion Expedition's haven in the Ruuan Weald, open to Alliance and Horde alike, where the tauren Tree Warden Chawn leads the druids' effort to restore the balance of the mountains. The weald around it is being cut and hunted bare by the Wyrmcult, which worships the surviving black dragons from its Blackwing Coven, while to the north the arakkoa of Grishnath whisper of a coming raven.

parts.body: The cult's second in command presses for the weald's lumber and livestock to prove the cult worthy of elevation among the Blackwing, and its dragonkin patriarch readies an assault to wipe the druids out.

title: Singing Ridge
body: The Singing Ridge is a field of great crystals in the south of the mountains, their shards humming with harmonies a gnome scholar suspects are a sign of life, perhaps bound to the nether drakes that nest there. The drakes are a strange inheritance: their eggs were black dragon eggs, changed by the wave of nether energy that washed over the land when Draenor blew apart.

title: Death's Door
body: Death's Door is a canyon south of Mok'Nathal Village where the Burning Legion holds open a portal onto the world in which it breeds its hounds. A hound-master keeps the ritual alive, warp-gates move and empower the void terrors that come through, and fel cannons guard them. To the druids of Evergrove it is the gravest danger the Legion poses in the mountains; north of it, a forge camp's fel corrupters twist the beasts of the Bladed Gulch.
